perspective:
Angela Hwang’s available information:

- She and Kevin Flores have been close friends since high school and confide in each other.
- She knows Kevin works as a construction worker and had noticed he seemed unhappy with his job, so she invited him to coffee to discuss it.
- At coffee, Kevin told her: he was “alright” but had the usual grind; he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions. He had thought about changing jobs/careers but didn’t know where to start and felt overwhelmed. Angela offered to look into options together. Kevin agreed and thanked her.
- Later, Angela found job openings and a career counseling service and shared them with Kevin. He thanked her. Kevin told her he had been thinking a lot and was interested in something more creative, maybe design or architecture. Angela encouraged him and suggested he check the resources. He said he would and thanked her.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant, so she arranged a meeting with a career coach. She told him she believed in him. Kevin said she didn’t have to, appreciated it, but wasn’t sure he was ready. Angela said the coach could help him plan and gain confidence. Kevin agreed to try. Angela promised support. He thanked her.
- Angela checked in about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach had been helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident. Angela said she was proud and offered more help. Kevin said just knowing she was there was enough and he would tell her if he needed anything. Angela said she would always be there. He thanked her.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned, so she organized a small celebration party. She told him. Kevin thanked her. Angela said he deserved it for his hard work and progress. Kevin said he was grateful and couldn’t have done it without her. Angela said he did the hard work and suggested enjoying the party. Kevin agreed.
